title: Data Backup Routine Timeline
description: A semester of backups in five checkpoints, only two of which need a person -- and the one that matters is the restore test, not the backup.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Tracking Student Data and Managing Club Communication

educational.audience: Club leaders responsible for student records and consent forms

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a semester calendar, the learner schedules backup and restore-verification checkpoints at appropriate intervals.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click-to-explore semester timeline separating automatic backups from manual verification checkpoints
pedagogical.assessment: Hand the learner a blank semester calendar and ask where the manual checkpoints go and what each one does.
